needs: state in caller-provided int slices (&k [int] to read, &!k [int] to mutate, two of them with distinct regions)
binary search over a prefix of a slice (n, not len)
in-place shifting loops (right on insert, left on remove) with while only, no break
a fixed capacity read from len(keys)
a count passed in and returned; -1 as the full signal
pitfalls: `val` is a keyword in cancho: a parameter or local named `val` does not parse (the brief says `value`)
replace-on-equal-key must win over the full check: replacing in a full map returns n, not -1
a full-map insert must leave keys[0..n) and vals[0..n) untouched (no half-shift before discovering it)
shifting must move vals together with keys, in the right direction (insert from the top down, remove from the bottom up)
searching len(keys) instead of n reads the garbage tail (the audit fills it with -999, below every key)
lower_bound is the first key >= k, not > k; count_in_range is lo-inclusive hi-exclusive and 0 when lo >= hi
mid = (lo + hi) / 2 and key subtraction overflow at the int extremes (the oracle uses +-9223372036854775807 and 2^62)
capacity 0: insert returns -1, nothing may index keys[0]
remove of the last entry must not read keys[n] / vals[n]; remove of an absent key returns n
a stored value 0 or -1 must still come back as Some, not be confused with a not-found sentinel
no break/continue; mutating slice params need &! in the signature
difficulty_notes: L3 stateful data structure. Five small functions, 60 reference lines. The state is the caller's two int slices plus a count that the mutating calls return, chosen because it is how cancho passes state (no &mut self, no struct field of type [T]) and keeps every function a small pure-ish unit checkable from a literal pre-state. The audit resets the arrays to the oracle's pre-state before every op (tail = -999) so a wrong function costs only its own group; the oracle (25 sequences, 879 ops: 9 hand-built edge sequences incl. capacity 0/1, full+replace, extremes, plus 16 seeded random runs over caps 3/8/16) is a dict cross-checked against a bisect twin and hand asserts. Plan examples/tests overlap the brief's capacity-4 worked example {10,20,30} with the oracle only in a few canonical points.
